findings.subject: W02 replacement timing and evidence
findings.detail: W02 was rejected by registration-free geometry before any backend result. Planning W04 under the preregistered GEOMETRY_ONLY_INELIGIBLE reason is prebackend and retains W02 assets.

findings.subject: W04 admission
findings.detail: W04 may occupy the weak-scene slot only after three passing stations, 30 frozen snapshots, and all preregistered WEAK geometry gates pass. A new verified freeze and lock are required.

findings.subject: Proposed 360 identity-initialization mainline
findings.detail: The active preregistration defines a multi-magnitude, signed weak/strong-direction capture-basin experiment. It does not make one identity-initialization run per snapshot/backend the active formal scientific endpoint.

findings.subject: T0 versus backend contract T_reference
findings.detail: The backend contract names the supplied initial transform T_reference. Current stationary MAP/QUERY canonical inputs use identity. Every future trial must bind an explicit track and exact locked T0; identity must not be silently substituted for a capture-basin perturbation.

findings.subject: Backend identity and parameters
findings.detail: Only open3d 0.19.0+b012259 and pcl 1.15.1 under backend contract SHA256 6a1ebdee6b34390f1430eab371e1c4108db1f124b59b7239d74785efa6474af9 are named; no scene-specific parameter adjustment is permitted.

findings.subject: Current readiness and authorization
findings.detail: FMB1 has only two admitted WEAK scenes, no active formal lock, and FORMAL_REGISTRATION_AUTHORIZED=false. No backend execution or publication is authorized.

findings.subject: Zero-perturbation amendment v1.1
findings.detail: The companion v1.1 amendment is PROPOSED_NOT_ACTIVE and has no formal authority. It cannot modify, supersede, or reinterpret the active preregistration.

findings.subject: Fixture publication
findings.detail: Schema-valid fixture rows remain fixture-only and can never be published or counted as formal measurements.
